y0: He came to fulfill the Word
y1: Jesus said, “I didn't come to destroy God's Law, but to fulfill it.”
y2: We need to obey God's Word from the heart, not just on the outside.
y4: “You were told, ‘Don't murder.’ But I tell you: being angry with your brother in your heart is also a sin.”
y5: “If you remember that your friend is upset with you when you bring a gift to God, go and reconcile with them first, then come back.”
y7: At that time, a Roman soldier could force people to carry his load for one mile.
y8: Jesus said, “Whoever forces you to go one mile, go with him two miles.” We should answer bad things with goodness, not with more bad things.
y10: “Love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you.”
y11: God makes His sun rise on both the good and the bad, and sends rain on everyone. We also become children who are like our Father in heaven.
verse: “Love your enemies, and pray for those who persecute you.”
prayer: Dear God, thank You for Your love that makes the sun rise on both the good and the bad. Help me to reconcile first with my friend when we argue. Let me not hate the people who hurt me, but pray for them. I pray in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.
d0: Law. These are the words and commands God gave through Moses. Jesus didn't come to destroy the Law.
d1: fulfill. To complete something perfectly, without missing anything. Jesus fulfilled the Word of God.
d2: reconcile. To become friendly again with someone you argued with. Go and reconcile with your friend first.
d3: goodness. A helpful and beautiful action. We answer bad things with goodness.
d4: enemy. Someone who hates us or hurts us. Jesus taught us to love our enemies.
d5: pray. To talk with God. We pray even for the people who hurt us.
